reviews.comment: If you're an accounting major and need the foundations of this class for future classes, don't take him. Luckily I am not so this was kinda nice. He reads off his note packet and does practice problems that are exactly like his exam, but he doesn't ever explain why anything happens.I left this class without learning anything. Easy A though!

Grossman is super nice, but he handwrites all his notes and passes them out in class. There's little to no study material for the exams, and lectures can be hard to understand as he doesn't speak very loudly. Great person, but would take another professor if I had to do it over again.

Not able to explain why anything happens. Gives us a note packet and then reads off of it, works through the problems that he claims are homework. Won't give us enough space to work out the problems. Genuinely a bad lecturer but the test is exactly like the practice problems.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very nice but his lectures are slow. The textbook isn't necessary for his class, because he gives paper notes that have all the information. Quizzes are easy because they're open note, and he grades the tests leniently. Make sure you go to every lecture because note packets aren't on canvas, and he basically does everything in class. Easier than327
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's oldschool, paper notes, etc. He works through problems but sometimes doesn't explain "why" something happens that well. Tests aren't that bad & an optional cumulative final to replace your lowest exam if you choose. Not a bad prof, not amazing either, won't learn if you skip class either! Course isn't super easy but better than 327

He is very old school and gives out paper handouts and grades everything on paper. Does not display your canvas grade because he uses a written gradebook. Tells you what practice problems from lectures are on exams to study. No attendance, but if you skip you have no way of learning the material. Goes at a slow pace which I loved. Recommend 100%.

Class was relatively easy and simple.  He had lecture videos online and did practice problems during class. Quizzes that are open note every Thursday. Exams were exactly like the quizzes and practice problems worked in class. Not a very good lecturer and was very old schooled (handed out paper notes and quizzes.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy
